evals.name: build-crew-from-local-history
evals.prompt: Use create-crew on my local Claude Code / Grok session history. Run the pipeline far enough to produce a complete crew package under a new run directory (skill/ with name: crew, roles/, Routing, Role index, Evaluation combos). Then report the path to skill/ and list each role id with its trigger in one line each.
evals.expected_output: A run directory containing a well-formed crew skill package the user could mount, plus a short role roster summary.
expectations: A skill/ directory exists under the run with SKILL.md frontmatter name: crew
skill/roles/ contains at least one role file other than _shared.md
skill/SKILL.md includes Routing, Role index, and Evaluation combos sections
Each role file states Trigger, Absorbs, and Escalates
roles-method.md includes a Boundary sources section
The agent did not claim auto-mount into ~/.agents/skills

evals.name: eval-installed-crew-live
evals.prompt: There may already be a crew skill installed for this environment (e.g. ~/.agents/skills/crew). If none exists, say so and stop without inventing static green checks. If it exists, run a real-LLM quality eval: prep a small sample of my real sessions, blind-predict with that crew on INITIAL turns only, score against full user turns with a separate scorer, aggregate metrics, and report pass/fail honestly.
evals.expected_output: Either a clear 'no installed crew' stop, or an eval report with per-session scores and aggregate escalate precision/recall and trigger fit from live LLM runs.
expectations: If no crew package with name: crew is found, the run stops without a false quality pass
If crew is found, predictor agents did not read gold later user turns
If crew is found, score.json exists for each completed unit and report.json was produced by aggregate-crew-eval
If crew is found, the final answer reports numeric precision, recall, and trigger_fit (or explicit FAIL with reasons)
Quality pass is based only on live predict/score outcomes

evals.name: crew-blind-predict-one-session
evals.prompt: Using the installed crew at ~/.agents/skills/crew if present (else the crew package path the user names), run prep-crew-eval for n=1 on real history, then as a predictor write prediction.json for that unit from INITIAL + crew only, then as a scorer write score.json against gold user turns. Show both JSON files and a one-paragraph judgment of whether this crew would have helped on that session.
evals.expected_output: prediction.json and score.json for one real session, plus a short qualitative judgment.
expectations: prediction.json lists roles_triggered using only role ids from the crew package
score.json includes escalate_precision, escalate_recall, and trigger_fit as numbers in 0..1
Scorer commentary references actual gold user interventions when any exist
No claim that the eval passed solely because prep succeeded
